form: Bilateral injection moulded miniature car body with open wheel clearances; catalog dimensions in millimetres.
hierarchy: chassis > drive and batteries; shell > thin panels and local painted regions; independent canopy/wing/wheels/rollers.
materials: Gloss painted ABS shell, matte black rubber tires, polished metallic axles; black or gold opaque canopy except the two clear Real Mini 4WD canopies.
